content.short: Solflare is a Solana software wallet that lets users send, receive, store, and securely stake SPL tokens.
content.description: Solflare is a secure, mobile crypto wallet that gives you convenient control over your tokens. From your phone you can buy, send, stake, swap, and trade tokens, and you can connect to Solana dApps to interact with decentralized services. The wallet also supports hardware wallets such as Ledger for enhanced security and provides blockchain notifications to keep you informed about on-chain activity. With Solflare you have a compact, secure gateway to managing crypto on the go.
